title: Wheelchair door rule needs a design speed the spec omits
why: Whether the 1000 mm rule applies depends on design speed, which is not supplied.

spec.name: Wheelchair door rule needs a design speed the spec omits

exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.required: ≥ 1000 mm if design speed < 250 km/h, else ≥ 800 mm
exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.rationale: 900 passes 800 but fails 1000, and whether 4.2.2.3.2(2) applies depends on the design speed, which the spec does not give.
